title: utilvo-pdf-merger: Zero-Dependency Binary PDF Stream Inspector & Merger SDK
description:
Open-source multi-language software development kit (Node.js, Python, Rust, Go, PHP, Ruby, Dart, Elixir, Swift, Lua, and .NET) for binary PDF header validation, FlateDecode (/ObjStm) cross-reference object stream decompression, accurate page-tree counting, and deterministic PDF stream concatenation.

Engineered as the companion library for the client-side Merge PDF document processing utility by Utilvo and Utilvo Shield.
